spatial_summary: Area-weighted mean across the Yukon admin-1 boundary (Natural Earth 1:10m)
weighting: Each ERA5-Land grid cell is weighted by the actual area of that cell lying inside Yukon.
boundary_method: A 50 km buffered Yukon boundary is used only for source-data extraction. Final spatial weighting uses intersection with the true unbuffered Yukon boundary.

trend.method: OLS linear trend with lag-1 HAC uncertainty
